summary: Full E2E testing of the new Two-Step Verification (email OTP) feature — backend (pytest, 8/8 passing) + frontend (Playwright, 3 viewports/flows). Every acceptance rule from the review request was verified end-to-end against the preview URL: (1) register auto-enables 2FA and returns JWT directly; (2) email+password login with 2FA ON returns {requires_2fa, pending_token, masked email} and NO token; the 6-digit code is written to backend.err.log with prefix '2FA code (dev, SMTP off) for <email> [login|toggle]'; (3) /api/auth/2fa/verify — wrong code -> 400 'Invalid authentication code', right code -> {user, token} + auth cookie; re-using consumed code -> 400; >5 wrong attempts on same code -> 429; (4) /api/auth/2fa/resend — immediately after login-issued code is throttled 429; after 31s a fresh resend succeeds and the very next one is throttled again; (5) /api/auth/2fa/request-toggle + /api/auth/2fa/confirm-toggle flips two_fa_enabled; after OFF a subsequent login returns token directly (no requires_2fa); after re-enable, login again requires code. UI: /login shows twofa-page with masked email hint, Sign-in disabled until 6 digits, wrong code renders twofa-error, Resend has countdown, Go back returns to login form; correct code redirects to /demo-trade. /profile shows twofa-section with status ON badge, opening the dialog and confirming toggle code flips to twofa-status-off with 'Two-step verification is ON/OFF' toast, and can be re-enabled the same way. Mobile 390x844: 2FA login page fits with no horizontal overflow (boxes width 308px).

issues: shadcn Dialog background appears semi-transparent so the underlying Personal Details section text bleeds through the dialog title/description — reduce dialog overlay opacity or set solid bg on DialogContent for readability. Non-blocking.
Date of birth uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than the shadcn calendar picker used elsewhere — cosmetic consistency issue, unrelated to 2FA feature.

critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes._consume_2fa_code: on the 6th attempt it marks used_at BEFORE checking the code hash — semantically correct (locks the code) and matches the 429 behavior tested, but note the message says 'Too many wrong attempts' even if the 6th happens to be correct. Acceptable trade-off.

TwoFACodeInput handleChange only appends digits — pasting via keyboard.type('123456') into box 0 works because each keystroke fires onChange and auto-advances. But there is no way to CLEAR/RESET the boxes from the UI other than Backspace; if a wrong code was entered, users must backspace 6x. Consider clearing the value on error automatically (nice-to-have).

Backend logs a plaintext 6-digit code when SMTP is off (dev convenience). Ensure smtp_configured() returns True in prod — currently guarded by 'if not smtp_configured()' which is correct, just a reminder for VPS deploy.

/api/auth/2fa/resend uses the latest un-used code's created_at for the 30s throttle. If a user's login-issued code is consumed successfully but then they somehow get back to the resend endpoint with the same pending_token (edge case), 'latest' returns None so resend would immediately issue a new code with no throttle — pending_token is single-use in practice via the /verify path, so low risk.
TwoFASection dialog: DialogContent lacks an explicit opaque background under the semi-transparent overlay, leading to the design issue noted above.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: login-2fa happy path, wrong code, go-back, toggle off, direct login after off, toggle back on, mobile viewport)

test_credentials: twofa1@test.com / Passw0rd123 (used and left in ON state at end of test). Also creates fresh ephemeral users twofa_reg_* and twofa_toggle_* per run (not cleaned up — see context).
seed_data_creation: New random users per test class in TestRegistration and TestToggleFlow (twofa_reg_<hex>@test.com, twofa_toggle_<hex>@test.com). No cleanup implemented — DB will accrue a handful of TEST users per pytest run; acceptable in the local dev DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 2FA suite reads 6-digit codes from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log via `grep -a '2FA code (dev' ...` — the log grep will pick up ALL historical codes, so always use `tail -1` (helper does this). Resend throttle test intentionally sleeps 31s so total pytest time ~33s. If backend restarts the .err.log is truncated and grep may need `-a`. UI toggle dialog uses testids `profile-twofa-code-input-0..5` and confirm button `profile-twofa-confirm`. To clear the code boxes you must press Backspace per digit (there is no keyboard-select workaround). twofa1@test.com is left with 2FA ON at end of run.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature works as specified.
